title: General jurisdiction and being at home
shortTitle: General jurisdiction and being at home
summary: General jurisdiction permits a court to hear claims against a defendant without requiring those claims to arise from forum activity. For a corporation, the assigned cases focus on whether it is essentially at home in the forum.
notes: Large sales, employees, or facilities do not automatically establish a corporate home. Consent-based jurisdiction under an explicit registration regime is separately analyzed in Mallory, rather than silently treated as a finding that the corporation is at home.

sections.How to work through the question: Begin with the usual corporate homes, incorporation and principal place of business.
